versions.text: See AMC.471 (a) The limit ground loads specified in this subpart are considered to be external loads and inertia forces that act upon a UAV structure. In each specified ground load condition, the external reactions must be placed in equilibrium with the linear and angular inertia forces in a rational or conservative manner. (b) The requirements described in USAR.473 to USAR.499 are not applicable to UAV designed to be recovered by parachute.
